intent: Dark-first marquee hero: a tight display headline over two or three slow rows of markup-drawn product screens drifting in opposite directions, masked at every edge, slowing under the pointer, with an optional tabletop tilt.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 (container queries, cqi units, CSS variables for theme tokens)
stack.animation: motion/react: variants with a custom start time, useInView, useReducedMotion, a spring for the tilt pose; one requestAnimationFrame loop per row for the drift

layout.section: @container, overflow hidden, near-black stage; copy column max-w 1320px, px 16/40/56px, pt 64/96/112px
layout.center: eyebrow, headline (max 15ch), body (max 52ch) and actions stacked and centred
layout.left: from @5xl a grid 1.45fr / 1fr aligned to the bottom: headline left (max 14ch), body and actions right; stacked below @5xl
layout.actions: 48px solid ink pill with an arrow plus an underlined text link, gap 24px, wrapping on phones
layout.band: mt 56/80px, pt 16px, pb 64/80px, overflow hidden, mask = intersect(horizontal transparent→#000 11%→#000 89%→transparent, vertical transparent→#000 7%→#000 78%→transparent)
layout.rows: gap 14/18px; each track holds three identical sets (clone, real, clone), translated by x − 1.5 × period so it overhangs both ends; sets repeat their screens until wider than the row (max 6 repeats)
layout.screen: designed on a 320 × 208 canvas (32px header, 176px body, 12px padding), scaled by --hms-s 0.72 / 0.84 @3xl / 0.92 @6xl; frame radius 12px, inset 1px hairline plus soft deep shadow
layout.phasing: row r starts 3 screens further along and at phase period × ((r × 0.41 + 0.17) mod 1), so screens never form columns
layout.pause: 44px round button bottom right (16px in, 32px from @3xl)

typography.screens: 10px UI text, 9px mono uppercase labels tracking 0.12em, 30px KPI figure tracking -0.04em, 17px mono invoice total; every figure tabular-nums

color.approach: monochrome; every tone is ink at an opacity; one accent prop, used once per screen
color.accent: #ff5a1f, international orange, meaning live or selected: eyebrow dot, In transit dots, the travelled part of the route and the vessel, today's bar, the pending customs arc, the typing dot, today's pickup rule, the booked quote's ring

motion.entrance: useInView 20% once: eyebrow 0s, headline words from 0.06s every 35ms, body 0.24s, actions 0.32s (opacity, y 12px, blur 8px, 600ms, cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)); rows from 0.46s every 80ms (y 24px, blur 8px, 750ms)
motion.drift: each row launches 0.45s after it lands; velocity eases to its goal with tau 0.8s up and 0.3s down; even rows left, odd rows right, at 1 / 0.78 / 1.14 × speed (default 22px/s); dt clamped to 50ms; transform written imperatively
motion.hover: the row under a mouse pointer eases to 20% of its speed; the card under the pointer lifts 4px and its hairline brightens over 200ms
motion.pause: button eases every row to 0 and back
motion.tilt: spring stiffness 180 damping 26 to rotateX 24deg, rotateZ -7deg, scale 1.16, perspective 1600px, origin 50% 35%
motion.power: loops run only while the band intersects the viewport and the tab is visible
motion.reducedMotion: rows static at their seeded phase, immediate opacity changes, no pause button

responsive.phone: screens at 0.72 scale (230px wide), copy stacked, actions wrap, pause button 16px from the corner
responsive.tablet: screens at 0.84, centred or stacked-left copy
responsive.desktop: screens at 0.92, left alignment splits into two columns from @5xl

accessibility: band is aria-hidden; a visually hidden sentence names every screen
pause button satisfies WCAG 2.2.2 and flips its aria-label between pause and play
CTAs are links with a 2px ink focus-visible ring offset 4px and a 0.97 press
hover slow-down is mouse only; touch scrolls normally
reduced motion freezes the rows and reveals content immediately

content.eyebrow: Halyard 3.0 · Freight ops for teams under twenty
content.headline: Run freight like a team of fifty.
content.body: Quotes, bookings, customs and invoices on one quiet desk. Halyard watches every container, so your four people only open the ones that need them.
content.screens: Shipments (5 refs, HLY-20418 NGB → RTM in transit), HLY-20418 tracking (MSC Aurelia, Ningbo → Rotterdam, day 23 of 37), INV-3307 (Kestrel Foods, £18,420.00, paid 3 Oct), Reliability (97.4% on time, +2.1 pts), Customs (3 of 4 documents), Brightline Haulage chat, Pickups week 42, Quotes (Corvid Line, Saltmarsh booked, Meridian Box)

avoid: screenshots, stock images or any network media
a different hue per screen or coloured traffic-light window chrome
a CSS keyframe marquee that snaps to a stop on hover
rows moving in lockstep or screens lining up into columns
hard edges where rows leave the band, or empty corners when tilted
gradient text, a glow behind the headline, an Introducing pill
Unlock, Supercharge, Seamless and other launch-copy filler
textContrast: Keep secondary text at least 65% of ink in both themes; selected, skipped and inactive content remains readable. Use outlines, status labels and icons for state instead of dimming whole content groups.
